findings.title: Phase counters can receive evidence from the other movement phase
findings.fact: Step4 or9 writes Masks/Distances indexed only by D.Facing. Step7 or12 writes PostWalkSeen/PostDistances the same way. Counters are not reset at phase entry. Phase exit reads fixed side0/1, without checking counted observations belong to that expected held-input phase.
findings.inference: Unexpected mixed facing in one earlier phase can pre-credit the later phase; later right/postcombo exit may use earlier evidence without its own full native D cycle or resumed Walk. This is a source control-flow finding, not a claimed runtime reproduction.
findings.required_change: Map counted Step to ExpectedSide; require exact D.Facing and held expected A XOR D plus compatible signed completed X movement; use reset/phase-owned counters. Independent verifier must derive each phase separately.
findings.status: Root forwarded to guard_two_process for NEWv003; v001/v002 explicitly not admitted.

findings.title: Screenshot observations add the same completed motion without uniqueness guard
findings.fact: Observe queries CompletedGroundMotion without consuming it and unconditionally increments IdleSeen/PostWalkSeen and adds M.WalkDistance on every processed screenshot. No uniqueness check uses D.DrawId or completed FromTime/ToTime. DungeonFighter.cpp1228-1236 confirms QueryCompletedGroundMotion is a pure getter.
findings.inference: Ordinary capture is normally once per rendered frame, but duplicate draw/callback sampling of the same completed motion can inflate actual-distance evidence or the minimum observation count. Source currently cannot reject this boundary; no duplicate runtime callbacks were claimed or generated.
findings.required_change: Retain every original capture Observation/Offset. Count draw evidence only for a new draw; add physical distance only for a unique completed-motion identity (run/owner/room/fromtime/totime), or explicitly fail duplicate evidence. Do not fabricate or drop capture rows.
findings.status: Specific source/API concern sent directly to guard_two_process forv003.

findings.title: Walk frame range/path stack is checked, but owner clock to frame is not independently derived
findings.fact: Observer requires D.Frame0..5 and expected profile paths, ordinary ground owner, native motion and matching simulation time. It does not derive DungeonGroundWalk::Frame(P.AnimationTime,Profile.Gait) and compare to D.Frame/WalkPhase. The inspected presenter does derive its frame from that clock.
findings.inference: The current presenter source corroborates ownership, so this is not a direct-forcing defect in the probe. Adding the independent derivation makes the acceptance boundary detect later presenter regressions.
findings.required_change: In counted Walk observations derive the expected frame from authoritative AnimationTime and the immutable Gait; compare D.Frame and logged WalkPhase to owner clock.
findings.status: Sent to guard_two_process as tightening suggestion.

findings.title: Already-started fixtures can skip Enter although report scope mentions actual Enter
findings.fact: Case0 pulses Enter only while bWaitingForStart; an already-running fixture progresses tobaseline without an Enter request.
findings.inference: Known waiting fixture can satisfy the scope normally. If this probe is reused with a started fixture, report scope should be narrowed or an initial-wait/actual Enter receipt asserted.
findings.required_change: Keep actual input requests truthful; for an actual-Enter claim verify an Enter press/release was observed in the fixture.
findings.status: Nonblocking scope caution, not a runtime failure claim.
